dossier.note: NOTE: [researcher note — Sérgio's voice, to write]
dossier.archive: ARCHIVE: link enabled in release builds
body: The warmest person in the room is the one
who refers you. The message you received was
kind, and it was real kindness — routed through
a network whose endpoint you did not choose.
What you typed in confidence became a record.
You saw it filed. You could not stop it.
